title: Towel Shelf 23-Inch Three Tier Hotel Style Drying Rack Solid Brass | Antique Brass | Towel Shelves | Allied Brass
short_title: Towel Shelf 23-Inch Three Tier Hotel Style Drying Rack, Antique Brass
description:
Keep folded towels and daily bath linens organized in one space-saving wall display in Antique Brass, which features a softened, aged golden patina that brings vintage charm and character to traditional spaces. This three tier hotel-style towel shelf adds storage above and a drying rack below for efficient bathroom organization.

Highlights:
- Antique Brass brings warm, timeless elegance
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Count on enduring bathroom performance with solid brass construction
- Coordinate your look with the towel shelves collection and multiple designer finish options
- Fits transitional bathroom hardware style for versatile bath accessories in guest baths and primary baths

Specs & Installation:
- Overall dimensions: 23 in L x 10 in H x 9 in W
- Shipping weight: 7 lbs
- Wall-mounted installation; mounting hardware included
- Some assembly required
- Assembled in the USA
